# دليل اجتياز اختبار فال — FAL Real Estate Exam Guide (Saudi Arabia)

> Independent Arabic-language study resource for Saudi Arabia's FAL (فال) real
> estate brokerage and marketing licensing exam, written by a REGA-licensed
> broker who passed the exam in August 2026. Includes a free interactive
> practice exam, a study guide, and topic summaries.

Language: Arabic (ar-SA). Audience: real estate practitioners in Saudi Arabia
preparing for the FAL qualification assessment.

Independence notice: This site is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or
representing the Real Estate General Authority (الهيئة العامة للعقار / REGA)
or the Saudi Real Estate Institute (المعهد العقاري السعودي / SREI). All
practice questions are original, written for training purposes from public
knowledge of the Real Estate Brokerage Law (Royal Decree M/130) and its
implementing regulations. They are not actual exam questions and passing is
not guaranteed.

## Key facts
- The FAL licence is required to practise real estate brokerage and marketing
  in Saudi Arabia.
- Qualification runs through accredited training programmes, each concluding
  in an electronic assessment.
- The documented pass mark used in the qualification assessments is 60%.
- The heaviest exam topic is the Real Estate Brokerage Law (Royal Decree
  M/130) and its implementing regulations, followed by the brokerage contract
  and commission (السعي), then real estate advertising and its licensing.

## Pages
- [Free interactive practice exam](https://azoz778.github.io/fal-guide/quiz/): 20 original
  multiple-choice questions, instant scoring against the 60% pass mark, and an
  explanation of the correct answer for every question. No signup or email.
- [Main study guide](https://azoz778.github.io/fal-guide/): exam topics and their
  relative weight, common traps, five practical tips, and a one-day study plan.
- [Practice question models](https://azoz778.github.io/fal-guide/questions/): worked
  example questions with reasoning on how distractor options are constructed.
- [Brokerage Law M/130 summary](https://azoz778.github.io/fal-guide/m130/): summary of the
  heaviest exam topic.
- [Exam registration steps](https://azoz778.github.io/fal-guide/tasjil/): how to register.
